title: Stationarity under repeated walks
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree, and let $p$ assign a rational number to each vertex. If one step of the random walk preserves $p$, then for every nonnegative integer $k$, the distribution obtained by applying the $k$-step walk transition probabilities to $p$ is again $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ assigns a rational number to each vertex
$p$ is stationary under one step of the walk
